items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: The last time I saw him was in France. Yeah. We was over there together.

ctx.x: What about one other trumpet player I was thinking about? Buck Clayton?
That's who I was trying to think of. A few minutes ago when you asked me about Count? Yeah. That's the name. That's the trumpet player - Buck Clayton.
